missing_spec_content.spec_text: Students should be able to recognise/draw simple diagrams to model the difference between solids, liquids and gases.
missing_spec_content.why: The lesson has no particle diagrams: every keyPoint has "diagram": null. It also never describes what a simple particle diagram of a solid, liquid and gas looks like, so the student is not shown how to recognise or draw one. keyPoints[3].content describes spacing only in words ("the particles are very far apart", "still close together, but not in a regular pattern").

missing_spec_content.spec_text: The particle model can be used to explain - the different states of matter
missing_spec_content.why: keyPoints[3].content uses the particle model only to explain differences in density. It never states the arrangement of particles in a solid. It says liquid particles are "not in a regular pattern" but never says solid particles are in a regular, fixed arrangement. So the particle-model description of the three states is incomplete.
